notes.title: Just over one year later...
notes.content:
Hello, It's been 1 year since you guys have heard from me. I apologize for that but a lot of stuff has happened in my personal life. aside from that The River is undergoing a complete revamp of its game play and mechanics on how the game is played and the background stuff no one sees. to make a better play experience all around for you guys. I hope to have a teaser video out for you on or before the 1st of January, 2022.
 
Thank You,
Josh.

notes.title: Silent Progression
notes.content:
Well Hello, It's been a while since you guys have heard directly from me. Josh the owner and creator of The River, I would just like to say thank you to all of you who have taken the time to either play the game or at least look at the games page. I have been working on another update and this update will bring bug fixes more than it will new content but I will attempt to push a little of that in there too for you guys!. during the week I only have about 2 hours of free time to work on the game before I have to put my little one to bed and then so myself.  On the weekends I try to work late into the night to get progress made.  The next update may take a month or so (holidays and all that) but I promise you that when this update drops you are going to want to play it and see what it has to offer this time!.

Thank You,
Josh.

notes.title: Happy Thanksgiving!!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello there![/b][/h1] Dev Hunter here wishing you all a [b]Happy Thanksgiving![/b] We all have a lot to be thankful for, but ourselves at Mad Scientist Studios would like formally say "Thank you!" to all of you! We are extremely grateful for all of your support in our project! Amid the holiday festivities, we wanted to update you and let you know our "Massive Update" is on schedule! We plan to release this Sunday at the same time as posted! We can't wait to see what you think and hope to keep bringing you enjoyable and diverse content for the foreseeable future! Again, Happy Thanksgiving to you all, enjoy the holidays, and keep your eyes and ears open for our next announcement!

[b]- Mad Scientist Studios[/b]

notes.title: Content Update
notes.content:
This weeks update brings some additional content for level 1. There is now a memory and a key to find. When the memory isn't found, you can come back to the level to search again. We've also made various bug fixes and QOL improvements you can see listed below. As always, let us know what you are thinking of the game so far and what you would like to see implemented by commenting on this post or in our discord. 

[list]
[*] Added Memory to level 1
[*] Added another scare
[*] Added key to escape level 1
[*] Lowered volume of thunder
[*] Added link to main menu to learn about PTSD
[*] Replaced doors in level 1 house with regular interior doors
[/list]

[b]- Mad Scientist Studios[/b]

notes.title: New Beta Release!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34301985/1f9b1edc76ddd9dae567faa4641cf73ce7b58f2b.png[/img][h1][b]Hello there![/b][/h1] Your favorite dev Hunter here yet again, how is everyone enjoying the new beta?? The team was super excited to get this pushed out to you and we really hope your enjoying it. We also recognize that there isn't a ton of content right now and wanted to let you know to not be worried! We are working our asses off to get more updates out to you guys. Think of this like a small little taste, the big reward is coming soon! Also if you are enjoying the beta and want to let us know what you think, be sure to head over to the #the-river-bugs-and-feedback chat in our discord and tell us! You can also comment on this post here, we check all of our platforms often. Also if you find any glitches or bugs be sure to post them in there so we can knock em out. Thank you for your time and can't wait to hear from you all :) 
- Hunter, Lead Level Designer

notes.title: The game is not dead or abandoned
notes.content:
as the summary said (if you read it) so ill post here as well...

"So basically I'm a one man team at this point and trying to get the game better for a future update with a day job working 9 hour days 5 days a week"

I am still working on the game slowly with the free time I do get. Please do not think the game is dead or abandoned cause it simply is not.

For those of you who have played it so far yes i know a lot is most likely broken and does not work correctly I am working on that (obviously) but please have patience with me and most likely the game as you know it now will not be the same when I release the 1.0 update.

I do not have a time frame for release but if i did i would say around end of summer this year 2020.

Stay safe have fun and avoid Covid-19 at all costs.

Thank You,

Developer Josh
